answer: An agent marketplace requires every identity, including cedar, glacier, and ripple, to lock 100 tokens for 30 days before bidding, with one active bid allowed per deposit. Creating new keys provides no extra bidding capacity unless each key posts its own bond. An attacker seeking 1,000 simultaneous bids must immobilize 100,000 tokens for a month, paying financing costs and bearing token price risk even if no misconduct is detected.
